Title

Top 200 Drugs Bundle, Pharmacology Flashcards and Cheat Sheets Printable, Nursing Student Study Guide, NCLEX Pharm Review PDF

125 characters (Etsy max 140).

Keywords — 13 tags

top 200 drugs, pharmacology bundle, nursing flashcards, drug cheat sheet, pharm flashcards, nclex study guide, nursing student, pharmacy student, drug cards printable, pharm study guide, nursing school, printable flashcards, nursing bundle

Description

The complete Top 200 drugs study set: 200 printable flashcards plus 27 cheat sheets, together for less than buying them separately.

Both cover the same 200 drugs in the same order, grouped by body system and drug family, so you can read a system on the cheat sheets and then quiz yourself on the matching cards.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Top 200 Drugs Flashcards
• 200 double-sided cards, 9 per page
• Front: drug name, warning strip, class, uses, MOA, side effects, nursing notes and a My Notes box
• Back: drug class, color-coded by body system, for self-quizzing
• Cover, setup page with printing tips and a full color key, printer alignment test, terms page
• 51 pages

Top 200 Drugs Cheat Sheets
• 27 landscape cheat sheets, 9 drugs per page
• Every row: drug and brand name, boxed warning and high-alert flags, class, uses, MOA, side effects, nursing notes
• Cover, contents page with page numbers, terms page
• 30 pages

You receive 4 PDF files: each product in US Letter and A4.

HOW TO USE
1. Download your PDF files after purchase.
2. Read a body system on the cheat sheets.
3. Print the flashcards double-sided on cardstock (flip on the long edge, 100% / actual size), cut, and quiz yourself.
4. Cover a column on the cheat sheets to review before an exam.

PERFECT FOR
Nursing students (ADN, BSN, LPN), pharmacy and pharmacy technician students, NCLEX and pharmacology exam review, and new nurses refreshing their pharm knowledge.

PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Colors may vary slightly depending on your printer and screen.
• For personal study use only. Please do not share, resell or redistribute the files.
• This is an educational study aid, not a clinical reference. Always verify drug information with current references and follow your program's and facility's guidance.
• Not affiliated with or endorsed by the NCSBN or NCLEX.
